module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Classes
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap
public import Mathlib.Basic.FunLike.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.UnitInterval

import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Star
import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel

/-!
# Nonlinear asymptotic *-morphisms

Only each fixed-coefficient time orbit is continuous. The slices are arbitrary
functions, not necessarily linear or continuous in the coefficient. Boundedness
and sharp asymptotic contractivity are the separate derived Proposition25.1.3,
not fields or premises of this definition. This generic data is motivated by
Blackadar's Definition25.1.1.

The source's four norm-defect limits are equivalently vector limits to zero in
the given normed topology. Homotopy data uses the ACTUAL compact continuous
function algebra and its norm, with exact endpoint values. No homotopy quotient,
E-group or KK object is defined before its own real prerequisites.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter

universe uA uB

/-- The half-line time domain, with its induced real topology and order. -/
abbrev AsymptoticTime := Set.Ici (1 : ℝ)

/-- An asymptotic *-morphism with arbitrary nonlinear slices and no boundedness premise. -/
structure AsymptoticMorphism
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] where
  /-- The raw time-indexed maps; individual slices need not be linear. -/
  toFun : AsymptoticTime → A → B
  continuous_orbit : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => toFun t a
  add_defect_tendsto : ∀ a b : A,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => toFun t (a + b) - (toFun t a + toFun t b))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  smul_defect_tendsto : ∀ (z : ℂ) (a : A),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => toFun t (z • a) - z • toFun t a)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  mul_defect_tendsto : ∀ a b : A,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => toFun t (a * b) - toFun t a * toFun t b)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  star_defect_tendsto : ∀ a : A,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => toFun t (star a) - star (toFun t a))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

@[macro_inline]
instance instFunLike : FunLike (AsymptoticMorphism A B) AsymptoticTime (A → B) where
  coe := AsymptoticMorphism.toFun
  coe_injective := by
    intro φ ψ h
    cases φ
    cases ψ
    cases h
    rfl

/-- The stored nonlinear time family is the actual public function coercion. -/
@[simp]
theorem toFun_eq_coe (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    φ.toFun = (φ : AsymptoticTime → A → B) := by
  rfl

/-- Asymptotic morphisms are determined by their values; their remaining fields are proofs. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), φ t a = ψ t a) : φ = ψ :=
  DFunLike.ext φ ψ (fun t => funext (h t))

/-- The zero orbit tends to zero; exact zero at every finite time is NOT assumed. -/
theorem zero_tendsto (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => φ t 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  change Filter.Tendsto (fun t : AsymptoticTime => φ.toFun t (0 : A))
    Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : B))
  simpa only [zero_smul, sub_zero] using
    φ.smul_defect_tendsto (0 : ℂ) (0 : A)

/-- Strict equivalence is the source's pointwise-in-coefficient vanishing difference. -/
def StrictlyEquivalent (φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : A, Filter.Tendsto (fun t => φ t a - ψ t a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem strictlyEquivalent_refl (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    StrictlyEquivalent φ φ := by
  intro a
  simp only [sub_self]
  exact tendsto_const_nhds

theorem strictlyEquivalent_symm {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : StrictlyEquivalent φ ψ) : StrictlyEquivalent ψ φ := by
  intro a
  simpa only [neg_sub, neg_zero] using (h a).neg

theorem strictlyEquivalent_trans {φ ψ χ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h₁ : StrictlyEquivalent φ ψ) (h₂ : StrictlyEquivalent ψ χ) :
    StrictlyEquivalent φ χ := by
  intro a
  have heq : (fun t => φ t a - χ t a) =
      (fun t => (φ t a - ψ t a) + (ψ t a - χ t a)) := by
    funext t
    abel
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [zero_add] using (h₁ a).add (h₂ a)

theorem strictlyEquivalent_equivalence
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Equivalence (StrictlyEquivalent : AsymptoticMorphism A B →
      AsymptoticMorphism A B → Prop) :=
  { refl := strictlyEquivalent_refl
    symm := strictlyEquivalent_symm
    trans := strictlyEquivalent_trans }

/-- An actual strict-equivalence setoid, NOT the source's homotopy quotient [[A,B]]. -/
def strictSetoid
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Setoid (AsymptoticMorphism A B) where
  r := StrictlyEquivalent
  iseqv := strictlyEquivalent_equivalence A B

/-- A genuine homomorphism-valued time family with exactly its point-norm continuity. -/
def ofHomFamily (f : AsymptoticTime → A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => f t a) : AsymptoticMorphism A B where
  toFun t a := f t a
  continuous_orbit := hf
  add_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    simpa only [map_add, sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  smul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro z a
    simpa only [map_smul, sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  mul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    simpa only [map_mul, sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  star_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a
    simpa only [map_star, sub_self] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

@[simp]
theorem ofHomFamily_apply (f : AsymptoticTime → A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t => f t a) (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ofHomFamily f hf t a = f t a := by
  rfl

/-- The actual constant family of an ordinary star homomorphism. -/
def ofHom (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) : AsymptoticMorphism A B :=
  ofHomFamily (fun _ => f) (fun _ => continuous_const)

@[simp]
theorem ofHom_apply (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ofHom f t a = f a := by
  rfl

/-- The actual zero input family, without any additive structure on all families. -/
def zero : AsymptoticMorphism A B :=
  ofHom (0 : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)

@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    zero (A := A) (B := B) t a = 0 := by
  rw [zero, ofHom_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.zero_apply]

/-- Actual continuous proper-at-infinity reparametrization.
Increasing is not an additional premise. -/
def reparam (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) :
    AsymptoticMorphism A B where
  toFun t a := φ (r t) a
  continuous_orbit a := (φ.continuous_orbit a).comp hr
  add_defect_tendsto a b := (φ.add_defect_tendsto a b).comp hrTop
  smul_defect_tendsto z a := (φ.smul_defect_tendsto z a).comp hrTop
  mul_defect_tendsto a b := (φ.mul_defect_tendsto a b).comp hrTop
  star_defect_tendsto a := (φ.star_defect_tendsto a).comp hrTop

@[simp]
theorem reparam_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (r : AsymptoticTime → AsymptoticTime) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hrTop : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : reparam φ r hr hrTop t a = φ (r t) a := by
  rfl

/-- An ACTUAL asymptotic family into C([0,1],B), with exact endpoint values.
The family's limits/continuity use this algebra's SUP norm, not pointwise s-limits. -/
structure Homotopy (φ₀ φ₁ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) where
  /-- The whole interval-valued asymptotic family defining this homotopy. -/
  family : AsymptoticMorphism A C(unitInterval, B)
  start : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), family t a 0 = φ₀ t a
  finish : ∀ (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A), family t a 1 = φ₁ t a

namespace Homotopy

/-- A homotopy is determined by its actual family; endpoint fields are proofs. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {φ₀ φ₁ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} {H K : Homotopy φ₀ φ₁}
    (h : H.family = K.family) : H = K := by
  cases H
  cases K
  cases h
  rfl

end Homotopy

/-- Homotopy uses the actual family above, not an arbitrary supplied relation. -/
def Homotopic (φ₀ φ₁ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (Homotopy φ₀ φ₁)

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.VanishingIdeal
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.LatticeIntervals
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Compact

/-!
# The literal asymptotic C-star algebra and quotient lifts

AsymptoticAlgebra B is the actual Cb([1,infty),B)/C0([1,infty),B)
quotient, using the stock bounded-continuous algebra, the constructed closed
star ideal, and the existing quotient C-star factory. Its norm is not changed.

A set-theoretic lifting of an actual homomorphism into this quotient gives a
raw nonlinear asymptotic family. Its four laws are derived from the actual
kernel criterion. No Source bound theorem or extra raw bound premise is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Filter
open scoped ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

universe uA uB

/-- The genuine quotient of bounded time-functions by those vanishing at infinity. -/
abbrev AsymptoticAlgebra (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).Quotient

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- Explicit existing quotient C-star data. It is not globally registered. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def cStarAlgebra (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (AsymptoticAlgebra B) :=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientCStarAlgebra

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

/-- The actual quotient projection, with the preceding fixed quotient dictionaries. -/
def quotientMap (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B :=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientMap

private theorem ray_cocompact_eq_atTop :
    cocompact AsymptoticTime = (atTop : Filter AsymptoticTime) := by
  let : OrderBot AsymptoticTime := Set.Ici.orderBot
  let : NoMaxOrder AsymptoticTime :=
    ⟨fun t =>
      ⟨⟨(t : ℝ) + 1, t.property.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one)⟩,
        lt_add_one (t : ℝ)⟩⟩
  let : ClosedIciTopology AsymptoticTime :=
    ⟨fun t => (isClosed_Ici : IsClosed (Set.Ici (t : ℝ))).preimage
      continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let : CompactIccSpace AsymptoticTime :=
    ⟨fun {a b} => by
      apply Subtype.isCompact_iff.mpr
      have himage : Subtype.val '' (Set.Icc a b : Set AsymptoticTime) =
          Set.Icc (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
          exact ht
        · intro hx
          exact ⟨⟨x, a.property.trans hx.1⟩, hx, rfl⟩
      rw [himage]
      exact isCompact_Icc⟩
  exact cocompact_eq_atTop

/-- The actual ideal on the closed ray is characterized by atTop vanishing. -/
theorem mem_vanishingIdeal_iff (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    f ∈ BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B ↔
      Tendsto f atTop (nhds 0) := by
  rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff, ray_cocompact_eq_atTop]

/-- Zero in the real quotient is exactly vanishing at infinity. -/
theorem quotientMap_eq_zero_iff (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    quotientMap B f = 0 ↔ Tendsto f atTop (nhds 0) := by
  change (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientMap f = 0 ↔ _
  rw [ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]

/-- Equality of quotient classes is precisely the vanishing-difference criterion. -/
theorem quotientMap_eq_iff (f g : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    quotientMap B f = quotientMap B g ↔
      Tendsto (fun t => f t - g t) atTop (nhds 0) := by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, quotientMap_eq_zero_iff]
  rfl

/-- The canonical C0 inclusion has zero quotient class. -/
theorem quotientMap_toBCF (f : C₀(AsymptoticTime, B)) :
    quotientMap B f.toBCF = 0 :=
  ((BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientMap_eq_zero_iff
    f.toBCF).2 (BoundedContinuousFunction.toBCF_mem_vanishingIdeal f)

/-- Surjectivity is inherited from the actual Submodule quotient, not assumed. -/
theorem quotientMap_surjective (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Function.Surjective (quotientMap B) :=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B).quotientMap_surjective

/-- Any genuine set-theoretic lifting of a quotient hom yields a raw family.
F is arbitrary in the coefficient; no linearity or continuity-in-a is imposed. -/
def ofLift (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B)
    (F : A → AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (hF : ∀ a : A, quotientMap B (F a) = ρ a) : AsymptoticMorphism A B where
  toFun t a := F a t
  continuous_orbit a := (F a).continuous
  add_defect_tendsto a b := by
    have hzero : quotientMap B (F (a + b) - (F a + F b)) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sub, map_add, hF, sub_self]
    have h := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
    exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply])
  smul_defect_tendsto z a := by
    have hzero : quotientMap B (F (z • a) - z • F a) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sub, map_smul, hF, sub_self]
    have h := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
    exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply])
  mul_defect_tendsto a b := by
    have hzero : quotientMap B (F (a * b) - F a * F b) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sub, map_mul, hF, sub_self]
    have h := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
    exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.mul_apply])
  star_defect_tendsto a := by
    have hzero : quotientMap B (F (star a) - star (F a)) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sub, map_star, hF, sub_self]
    have h := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
    exact h.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun (t : AsymptoticTime) => by
      simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.star_apply])

/-- The lifting family has the original pointwise values. -/
@[simp]
theorem ofLift_apply (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B)
    (F : A → AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (hF : ∀ a : A, quotientMap B (F a) = ρ a)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : ofLift ρ F hF t a = F a t := by
  rfl

/-- Two set-theoretic liftings of the same quotient map are strictly equivalent. -/
theorem strictlyEquivalent_ofLift (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B)
    (F G : A → AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B)
    (hF : ∀ a : A, quotientMap B (F a) = ρ a)
    (hG : ∀ a : A, quotientMap B (G a) = ρ a) :
    AsymptoticMorphism.StrictlyEquivalent (ofLift ρ F hF) (ofLift ρ G hG) := by
  intro a
  have h := (quotientMap_eq_iff (F a) (G a)).1 ((hF a).trans (hG a).symm)
  simpa only [ofLift_apply] using h

/-- Actual quotient surjectivity supplies a set-theoretic lift by choice.
This choice constructs the family; it is not an output-model input. -/
def ofHom (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B) : AsymptoticMorphism A B :=
  ofLift ρ
    (fun a => Classical.choose (quotientMap_surjective B (ρ a)))
    (fun a => Classical.choose_spec (quotientMap_surjective B (ρ a)))

/-- Characteristic values of the computed set-theoretic lift. -/
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_apply (ρ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ofHom ρ t a =
      (Classical.choose (quotientMap_surjective B (ρ a)) : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) t := by
  rfl

end AsymptoticAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.BoundedHom

/-!
# Functoriality of the literal asymptotic algebra

Coefficient homomorphisms descend through the actual closed vanishing ideal.
Constant functions give a natural injective inclusion into the quotient.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter Set
open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction CStarAlgebra
  NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

universe uA uB uC

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

/-- The coefficient map on the literal asymptotic quotient. -/
@[no_expose]
def map (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    AsymptoticAlgebra A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let J := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let _ : J.carrier.IsTwoSided := J.isTwoSided
  exact NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.map I.carrier J.carrier
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_mapsTo_vanishingIdeal
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)

/-- The coefficient map is computed by postcomposing a bounded representative
and applying the actual target quotient projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem map_quotientMap (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)
    (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ A) :
    map φ (quotientMap A f) =
      quotientMap B
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ f) := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let J := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let _ : J.carrier.IsTwoSided := J.isTwoSided
  exact NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.map_mk I.carrier J.carrier
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_mapsTo_vanishingIdeal
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ) f

/-- Quotient coefficient maps intertwine the actual quotient projections. -/
theorem map_comp_quotientMap (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    (map φ).comp (quotientMap A) =
      (quotientMap B).comp
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
          (X := AsymptoticTime) φ) := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let J := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let _ : J.carrier.IsTwoSided := J.isTwoSided
  exact NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.map_comp_mk I.carrier J.carrier
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_mapsTo_vanishingIdeal
      (X := AsymptoticTime) φ)

@[simp]
theorem map_id (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    map (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) =
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (AsymptoticAlgebra A) := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  apply NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.hom_ext I.carrier
  change (map (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A)).comp (quotientMap A) =
    (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ (AsymptoticAlgebra A)).comp (quotientMap A)
  rw [map_comp_quotientMap,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_id]
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem map_zero (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    map (0 : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) = 0 := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  apply NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.hom_ext I.carrier
  change (map (0 : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B)).comp (quotientMap A) =
    (0 : AsymptoticAlgebra A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B).comp (quotientMap A)
  rw [map_comp_quotientMap,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_zero]
  rfl

/-- The literal quotient coefficient map respects composition. -/
theorem map_comp (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (ψ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    map (ψ.comp φ) = (map ψ).comp (map φ) := by
  let I := BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime A
  let _ : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  apply NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.hom_ext I.carrier
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro f
  change map (ψ.comp φ) (quotientMap A f) =
    map ψ (map φ (quotientMap A f))
  simp only [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply, map_quotientMap,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_comp]

private def boundedConstantHom
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ A) where
  toFun := BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime
  map_zero' := by ext t; rfl
  map_add' _ _ := by ext t; rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := by ext t; rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := by ext t; rfl
  map_star' _ := by ext t; rfl

/-- The actual constant-function class in the literal asymptotic quotient. -/
@[no_expose]
def constantHom (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra A :=
  (quotientMap A).comp (boundedConstantHom A)

@[simp]
theorem constantHom_apply
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] (a : A) :
    constantHom A a =
      quotientMap A
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime a) := by
  rfl

private theorem comp_constant
    (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (a : A) :
    BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ
        (BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime a) =
      BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime (φ a) := by
  ext t
  rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply]
  rfl

/-- The constant-class inclusion is natural in the coefficient algebra. -/
theorem map_comp_constantHom (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    (map φ).comp (constantHom A) = (constantHom B).comp φ := by
  ext a
  simp only [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply, constantHom_apply,
    map_quotientMap, comp_constant]

/-- A constant class is zero exactly when its coefficient is zero. -/
theorem constantHom_eq_zero_iff
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] (a : A) :
    constantHom A a = 0 ↔ a = 0 := by
  let _ : Nonempty AsymptoticTime := ⟨⟨1, le_rfl⟩⟩
  let _ : NeBot (atTop : Filter AsymptoticTime) := Filter.atTop_neBot
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [constantHom_apply] at h
    have ht := (quotientMap_eq_zero_iff
      (BoundedContinuousFunction.const AsymptoticTime a)).1 h
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => a) atTop (nhds a)) ht
  · rintro rfl
    exact _root_.map_zero (constantHom A)

/-- The coefficient algebra embeds in its asymptotic algebra by constant
classes, without a nontriviality hypothesis. -/
theorem constantHom_injective
    (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    Function.Injective (constantHom A) := by
  intro a b hab
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (constantHom_eq_zero_iff A (a - b)).1
  rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing

import Mathlib.Topology.Constructions

/-!
# Actual asymptotic homotopy equivalence and classes

Postcomposition uses a genuine nonunital star hom. Compatible homotopies are
paired in the actual closed endpoint pullback and glued by its star hom.
Thus time continuity and all four defects use the inherited supremum norm,
not pointwise-only interval convergence or a supplied orbit bound.

The Setoid and Quotient below are constructed from real reflexive, reversed
and concatenated homotopy data. No E-group, KK-group or additive law is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped CStarAlgebra

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB uC

section Postcomposition

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- Apply an actual star hom to an arbitrary nonlinear asymptotic family. -/
def postcomp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    AsymptoticMorphism A C where
  toFun t a := g (φ t a)
  continuous_orbit a := (map_continuous g).comp (φ.continuous_orbit a)
  add_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    have h := ((map_continuous g).tendsto 0).comp (φ.add_defect_tendsto a b)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, toFun_eq_coe, map_sub, map_add, map_zero] using h
  smul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro z a
    have h := ((map_continuous g).tendsto 0).comp (φ.smul_defect_tendsto z a)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, toFun_eq_coe, map_sub, map_smul, map_zero] using h
  mul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    have h := ((map_continuous g).tendsto 0).comp (φ.mul_defect_tendsto a b)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, toFun_eq_coe, map_sub, map_mul, map_zero] using h
  star_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a
    have h := ((map_continuous g).tendsto 0).comp (φ.star_defect_tendsto a)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, toFun_eq_coe, map_sub, map_star, map_zero] using h

@[simp]
theorem postcomp_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : postcomp φ g t a = g (φ t a) := by
  rfl

end Postcomposition

section Homotopies

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {φ ψ χ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}

open ContinuousMap.IntervalGluing

namespace Homotopy

/-- Pair two exact-compatible homotopies in the actual matching-endpoint
subalgebra. The time topology and defect limits are inherited product norms. -/
def pairFamily (H : Homotopy φ ψ) (K : Homotopy ψ χ) :
    AsymptoticMorphism A (MatchingPaths B) where
  toFun t a := NonUnitalCStarPullback.mk (evalAt B 1) (evalAt B 0)
    (H.family t a) (K.family t a) ((H.finish t a).trans (K.start t a).symm)
  continuous_orbit := by
    intro a
    exact ((H.family.continuous_orbit a).prodMk
      (K.family.continuous_orbit a)).subtype_mk
        (fun t => (H.finish t a).trans (K.start t a).symm)
  add_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (H.family t (a + b) - (H.family t a + H.family t b),
        K.family t (a + b) - (K.family t a + K.family t b)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : C(unitInterval, B)), (0 : C(unitInterval, B))))
    exact (H.family.add_defect_tendsto a b).prodMk_nhds
      (K.family.add_defect_tendsto a b)
  smul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro z a
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (H.family t (z • a) - z • H.family t a,
        K.family t (z • a) - z • K.family t a))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : C(unitInterval, B)), (0 : C(unitInterval, B))))
    exact (H.family.smul_defect_tendsto z a).prodMk_nhds
      (K.family.smul_defect_tendsto z a)
  mul_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a b
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (H.family t (a * b) - H.family t a * H.family t b,
        K.family t (a * b) - K.family t a * K.family t b))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : C(unitInterval, B)), (0 : C(unitInterval, B))))
    exact (H.family.mul_defect_tendsto a b).prodMk_nhds
      (K.family.mul_defect_tendsto a b)
  star_defect_tendsto := by
    intro a
    apply tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr
    change Filter.Tendsto (fun t =>
      (H.family t (star a) - star (H.family t a),
        K.family t (star a) - star (K.family t a)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds ((0 : C(unitInterval, B)), (0 : C(unitInterval, B))))
    exact (H.family.star_defect_tendsto a).prodMk_nhds
      (K.family.star_defect_tendsto a)

@[simp]
theorem pairFamily_val (H : Homotopy φ ψ) (K : Homotopy ψ χ)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) :
    ((pairFamily H K t a : MatchingPaths B) :
      C(unitInterval, B) × C(unitInterval, B)) = (H.family t a, K.family t a) := by
  rfl

/-- The literal constant-in-homotopy-parameter family. -/
def refl (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Homotopy φ φ where
  family := postcomp φ (constantHom B)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, constantHom_apply]
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, constantHom_apply]

/-- Reverse the interval parameter, retaining exact endpoint values. -/
def symm (H : Homotopy φ ψ) : Homotopy ψ φ where
  family := postcomp H.family (reverseHom B)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, reverseHom_zero]
    exact H.finish t a
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, reverseHom_one]
    exact H.start t a

/-- Concatenate exact-compatible homotopies through real closed-pullback gluing. -/
def trans (H : Homotopy φ ψ) (K : Homotopy ψ χ) : Homotopy φ χ where
  family := postcomp (pairFamily H K) (glueHom (B := B))
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, glueHom_zero, pairFamily_val]
    exact H.start t a
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, glueHom_one, pairFamily_val]
    exact K.finish t a

end Homotopy

theorem homotopic_refl (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : Homotopic φ φ :=
  ⟨Homotopy.refl φ⟩

theorem homotopic_symm {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : Homotopic φ ψ) : Homotopic ψ φ := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.symm⟩

theorem homotopic_trans {φ ψ χ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h₁ : Homotopic φ ψ) (h₂ : Homotopic ψ χ) : Homotopic φ χ := by
  rcases h₁ with ⟨H⟩
  rcases h₂ with ⟨K⟩
  exact ⟨H.trans K⟩

theorem homotopic_equivalence
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Equivalence (Homotopic : AsymptoticMorphism A B →
      AsymptoticMorphism A B → Prop) :=
  { refl := homotopic_refl
    symm := homotopic_symm
    trans := homotopic_trans }

/-- The Setoid is constructed from the actual homotopy data and its proofs. -/
def homotopySetoid
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Setoid (AsymptoticMorphism A B) where
  r := Homotopic
  iseqv := homotopic_equivalence A B

/-- Actual asymptotic homotopy classes, the quotient denoted [[A,B]].
No addition, group or E-theory structure is introduced here. -/
abbrev HomotopyClasses
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  Quotient (homotopySetoid A B)

/-- The class of an actual asymptotic family. -/
def mkClass (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : HomotopyClasses A B :=
  Quotient.mk _ φ

@[simp]
theorem mkClass_eq_mkClass_iff (φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    mkClass φ = mkClass ψ ↔ Homotopic φ ψ := by
  constructor
  · exact Quotient.exact
  · intro h
    exact Quotient.sound h

end Homotopies

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Homotopy
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.Hom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Homotopy
public import Mathlib.Data.Quot

/-!
# Fixed-hom functoriality and ordinary homomorphism inclusion

Only the composing map in pre/postcomposition is an actual star hom.
The other family remains arbitrary and nonlinear. No same-time composition
of two arbitrary asymptotic families is defined.

Ordinary classes are the real quotient of the existing point-norm Homotopic
predicate. Its proven equivalence is reused, and ofHom descends through the
actual constructed asymptotic homotopy quotient.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe uA uB uC uD

namespace NonUnitalStarAlgHom

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]

/-- The ordinary homotopy setoid, using the existing real hom-valued paths. -/
def homotopySetoid
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Setoid (A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) where
  r := Homotopic
  iseqv := Homotopic.equivalence A B

/-- The actual ordinary homomorphism homotopy classes [A,B]. -/
abbrev HomotopyClasses
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :=
  Quotient (homotopySetoid A B)

/-- The class of an actual star homomorphism in the point-norm homotopy quotient. -/
def mkHomotopyClass (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) : HomotopyClasses A B :=
  Quotient.mk _ f

@[simp]
theorem mkHomotopyClass_eq_iff (f g : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    mkHomotopyClass f = mkHomotopyClass g ↔ Homotopic f g := by
  constructor
  · exact Quotient.exact
  · intro h
    exact Quotient.sound h

/-- Contravariant fixed-hom action on actual ordinary classes. -/
def precompClass (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses C B :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid C B)
    (fun g => g.comp f) (by
    intro g h hgh
    exact Homotopic.precomp hgh f)

/-- Covariant fixed-hom action on actual ordinary classes. -/
def postcompClass (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses A C :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid A C)
    (fun f => g.comp f) (by
    intro f h hfh
    exact Homotopic.postcomp hfh g)

@[simp]
theorem precompClass_mk (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    precompClass f (mkHomotopyClass g) = mkHomotopyClass (g.comp f) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem postcompClass_mk (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    postcompClass g (mkHomotopyClass f) = mkHomotopyClass (g.comp f) := by
  rfl

end NonUnitalStarAlgHom

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D]

/-- Precompose by a fixed actual nonunital star hom.
No continuity or linearity of the asymptotic slice is added. -/
def precomp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    AsymptoticMorphism C B where
  toFun t a := φ t (f a)
  continuous_orbit a := φ.continuous_orbit (f a)
  add_defect_tendsto a b := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, map_add] using φ.add_defect_tendsto (f a) (f b)
  smul_defect_tendsto z a := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, map_smul] using φ.smul_defect_tendsto z (f a)
  mul_defect_tendsto a b := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, map_mul] using φ.mul_defect_tendsto (f a) (f b)
  star_defect_tendsto a := by
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, map_star] using φ.star_defect_tendsto (f a)

@[simp]
theorem precomp_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : C) : precomp φ f t a = φ t (f a) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem precomp_id (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    precomp φ (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) = φ := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  rw [precomp_apply]
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem postcomp_id (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    postcomp φ (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B) = φ := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  rw [postcomp_apply]
  rfl

theorem precomp_comp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : D →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    precomp (precomp φ f) g = precomp φ (f.comp g) := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [precomp_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]

theorem postcomp_comp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (h : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) :
    postcomp (postcomp φ g) h = postcomp φ (h.comp g) := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [postcomp_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]

theorem postcomp_precomp (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) :
    postcomp (precomp φ f) g = precomp (postcomp φ g) f := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [precomp_apply, postcomp_apply]

@[simp]
theorem precomp_ofHom (g : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    precomp (ofHom g) f = ofHom (g.comp f) := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [precomp_apply, ofHom_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]

@[simp]
theorem postcomp_ofHom (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    postcomp (ofHom f) g = ofHom (g.comp f) := by
  apply ext
  intro t a
  simp only [postcomp_apply, ofHom_apply, NonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp_apply]

namespace Homotopy

/-- Precompose the actual homotopy family by a fixed star hom. -/
def precomp {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (H : Homotopy φ ψ)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) : Homotopy (AsymptoticMorphism.precomp φ f)
      (AsymptoticMorphism.precomp ψ f) where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.precomp H.family f
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [precomp_apply, precomp_apply]
    exact H.start t (f a)
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [precomp_apply, precomp_apply]
    exact H.finish t (f a)

/-- Postcompose through the actual coefficient star hom on C([0,1],B). -/
def postcomp {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B} (H : Homotopy φ ψ)
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : Homotopy (AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp φ g)
      (AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp ψ g) where
  family := AsymptoticMorphism.postcomp H.family
    (ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom unitInterval g)
  start := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply, postcomp_apply]
    exact congrArg g (H.start t a)
  finish := by
    intro t a
    rw [postcomp_apply, ContinuousMap.compNonUnitalStarAlgHom_apply, postcomp_apply]
    exact congrArg g (H.finish t a)

end Homotopy

theorem homotopic_precomp {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : Homotopic φ ψ) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    Homotopic (precomp φ f) (precomp ψ f) := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.precomp f⟩

theorem homotopic_postcomp {φ ψ : AsymptoticMorphism A B}
    (h : Homotopic φ ψ) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    Homotopic (postcomp φ g) (postcomp ψ g) := by
  rcases h with ⟨H⟩
  exact ⟨H.postcomp g⟩

/-- An ordinary point-norm homotopy supplies a constant-in-time asymptotic
homotopy. The existing relation is an existential F, not a record assumed here. -/
theorem homotopic_ofHom {f g : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B}
    (h : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (ofHom f) (ofHom g) := by
  rcases h with ⟨F, h0, h1⟩
  refine ⟨{ family := ofHom F, start := ?_, finish := ?_ }⟩
  · intro t a
    rw [ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply]
    exact h0 a
  · intro t a
    rw [ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply]
    exact h1 a

/-- Contravariant fixed-hom action on actual asymptotic homotopy classes. -/
def precompClass (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses C B :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid C B)
    (fun φ => precomp φ f) (by
    intro φ ψ h
    exact homotopic_precomp h f)

/-- Covariant fixed-hom action on actual asymptotic homotopy classes. -/
def postcompClass (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses A C :=
  Quotient.map (sa := homotopySetoid A B) (sb := homotopySetoid A C)
    (fun φ => postcomp φ g) (by
    intro φ ψ h
    exact homotopic_postcomp h g)

@[simp]
theorem precompClass_mk (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    precompClass f (mkClass φ) = mkClass (precomp φ f) := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem postcompClass_mk (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    postcompClass g (mkClass φ) = mkClass (postcomp φ g) := by
  rfl

/-- The actual natural map [A,B]->[[A,B]]. -/
def ofHomClass : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.HomotopyClasses A B → HomotopyClasses A B :=
  Quotient.map (sa := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.homotopySetoid A B)
    (sb := homotopySetoid A B) ofHom (by
    intro f g h
    exact homotopic_ofHom h)

@[simp]
theorem ofHomClass_mk (f : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass f) = mkClass (ofHom f) := by
  rfl

theorem precompClass_id (q : HomotopyClasses A B) :
    precompClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) q = q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change precompClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ A) (mkClass φ) = mkClass φ
  rw [precompClass_mk, precomp_id]

theorem postcompClass_id (q : HomotopyClasses A B) :
    postcompClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B) q = q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change postcompClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.id ℂ B) (mkClass φ) = mkClass φ
  rw [postcompClass_mk, postcomp_id]

theorem precompClass_comp (q : HomotopyClasses A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : D →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    precompClass g (precompClass f q) = precompClass (f.comp g) q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change precompClass g (precompClass f (mkClass φ)) =
    precompClass (f.comp g) (mkClass φ)
  rw [precompClass_mk, precompClass_mk, precompClass_mk, precomp_comp]

theorem postcompClass_comp (q : HomotopyClasses A B)
    (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (h : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) :
    postcompClass h (postcompClass g q) = postcompClass (h.comp g) q := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change postcompClass h (postcompClass g (mkClass φ)) =
    postcompClass (h.comp g) (mkClass φ)
  rw [postcompClass_mk, postcompClass_mk, postcompClass_mk, postcomp_comp]

theorem postcompClass_precomp (q : HomotopyClasses A B)
    (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) :
    postcompClass g (precompClass f q) = precompClass f (postcompClass g q) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun φ => ?_
  change postcompClass g (precompClass f (mkClass φ)) =
    precompClass f (postcompClass g (mkClass φ))
  rw [precompClass_mk, postcompClass_mk, postcompClass_mk, precompClass_mk,
    postcomp_precomp]

theorem ofHomClass_precomp
    (q : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.HomotopyClasses A B) (f : C →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.precompClass f q) =
      precompClass f (ofHomClass q) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun g => ?_
  change ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.precompClass f
      (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass g)) =
    precompClass f (ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass g))
  rw [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.precompClass_mk, ofHomClass_mk, ofHomClass_mk,
    precompClass_mk, precomp_ofHom]

theorem ofHomClass_postcomp
    (q : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.HomotopyClasses A B) (g : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) :
    ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.postcompClass g q) =
      postcompClass g (ofHomClass q) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun f => ?_
  change ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.postcompClass g
      (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass f)) =
    postcompClass g (ofHomClass (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.mkHomotopyClass f))
  rw [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.postcompClass_mk, ofHomClass_mk, ofHomClass_mk,
    postcompClass_mk, postcomp_ofHom]

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.Basic

import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.MulAction
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Star
import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel

/-!
# Literal zero-normalization of asymptotic families

The original family need not send zero to zero at each finite time.
Subtract its actual zero orbit to obtain an exactly zero-preserving equivalent
family. All four asymptotic laws are proved directly from the original defects;
boundedness, B-infinity and unitization are NOT used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter

namespace AsymptoticMorphism

universe uA uB

variable {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- Subtract the actual vanishing zero orbit, preserving arbitrary nonlinear slices. -/
def normalize (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) : AsymptoticMorphism A B := by
  let f : AsymptoticTime → A → B := fun t a => φ t a - φ t 0
  refine
    { toFun := f
      continuous_orbit := ?_
      add_defect_tendsto := ?_
      smul_defect_tendsto := ?_
      mul_defect_tendsto := ?_
      star_defect_tendsto := ?_ }
  · intro a
    change Continuous fun t => φ t a - φ t 0
    exact (φ.continuous_orbit a).fun_sub (φ.continuous_orbit 0)
  · intro a b
    have heq : (fun t => f t (a + b) - (f t a + f t b)) =
        (fun t => (φ t (a + b) - (φ t a + φ t b)) + φ t 0) := by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, zero_add] using (φ.add_defect_tendsto a b).add φ.zero_tendsto
  · intro z a
    have heq : (fun t => f t (z • a) - z • f t a) =
        (fun t => (φ t (z • a) - z • φ t a) - φ t 0 + z • φ t 0) := by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [smul_sub]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    have hz : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => z • φ t 0) Filter.atTop (nhds (z • (0 : B))) :=
      (tendsto_const_nhds :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => z) Filter.atTop (nhds z)).smul
          φ.zero_tendsto
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, sub_zero, zero_add, smul_zero] using
      ((φ.smul_defect_tendsto z a).sub φ.zero_tendsto).add hz
  · intro a b
    have heq : (fun t => f t (a * b) - f t a * f t b) =
        (fun t =>
          (φ t (a * b) - φ t a * φ t b) -
          (φ t (a * 0) - φ t a * φ t 0) -
          (φ t (0 * b) - φ t 0 * φ t b) + φ t 0 - φ t 0 * φ t 0) := by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f]
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_mul, mul_sub]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    have hz := φ.zero_tendsto.mul φ.zero_tendsto
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, sub_zero, zero_add, zero_mul] using
      ((((φ.mul_defect_tendsto a b).sub (φ.mul_defect_tendsto a 0)).sub
        (φ.mul_defect_tendsto 0 b)).add φ.zero_tendsto).sub hz
  · intro a
    have heq : (fun t => f t (star a) - star (f t a)) =
        (fun t => (φ t (star a) - star (φ t a)) - φ t 0 + star (φ t 0)) := by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [star_sub]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [toFun_eq_coe, sub_zero, zero_add, star_zero] using
      ((φ.star_defect_tendsto a).sub φ.zero_tendsto).add φ.zero_tendsto.star

/-- Public characteristic formula, not an assumed chosen normalized family. -/
@[simp]
theorem normalize_apply (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B)
    (t : AsymptoticTime) (a : A) : normalize φ t a = φ t a - φ t 0 := by
  rfl

/-- Exact zero holds for the newly defined family, not for every original family. -/
theorem normalize_zero (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    normalize φ t 0 = 0 := by
  rw [normalize_apply, sub_self]

/-- The defined normalized family is strictly equivalent to its original. -/
theorem normalize_strictlyEquivalent (φ : AsymptoticMorphism A B) :
    StrictlyEquivalent (normalize φ) φ := by
  intro a
  have heq : (fun t => normalize φ t a - φ t a) = (fun t => -φ t 0) := by
    funext t
    rw [normalize_apply]
    abel
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [neg_zero] using φ.zero_tendsto.neg

end AsymptoticMorphism

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.AsymptoticMorphism.AsymptoticAlgebra
public import Mathlib.Order.Directed
public import Mathlib.Topology.Order.OrderClosed

/-!
# Actual tail ideals and restriction quotients

The kernel J_n of restriction to the true closed tail gives the exact
vanishing-on-[n,infty) ideal in Cb([1,infty),B). Clamp-extension is a computed
right inverse, hence the restriction quotient is the actual tail algebra.
No ideal comparison, inverse, lifting output or alternate C-star model is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Filter
open scoped ZeroAtInfty BoundedContinuousFunction

noncomputable section

namespace AsymptoticAlgebra

universe uB

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

attribute [local instance] cStarAlgebra

/-- The true source-domain tail; n=0,1 do not remove any source points. -/
abbrev TailTime (n : ℕ) := {t : AsymptoticTime // (n : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ)}

/-- Continuous inclusion of the actual tail in the original ray. -/
def tailInclusion (n : ℕ) : C(TailTime n, AsymptoticTime) :=
  ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩

@[simp]
theorem tailInclusion_apply (n : ℕ) (t : TailTime n) :
    tailInclusion n t = t.val := by
  rfl

/-- Actual continuous clamping, constant below the effective tail endpoint. -/
def tailClamp (n : ℕ) : C(AsymptoticTime, TailTime n) where
  toFun t :=
    ⟨⟨max (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ), t.property.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩, le_max_right _ _⟩
  continuous_toFun := by
    have hmax : Continuous (fun t : AsymptoticTime => max (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ)) :=
      continuous_subtype_val.max
        (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (n : ℝ)))
    exact (hmax.subtype_mk
      (fun t : AsymptoticTime => t.property.trans (le_max_left (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ)))).subtype_mk
        (fun t : AsymptoticTime => le_max_right (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ))

@[simp]
theorem tailClamp_coe (n : ℕ) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    ((tailClamp n t : AsymptoticTime) : ℝ) = max (t : ℝ) (n : ℝ) := by
  rfl

/-- Inclusion followed by clamp is the actual identity on the tail. -/
theorem tailClamp_inclusion (n : ℕ) (t : TailTime n) :
    tailClamp n (tailInclusion n t) = t := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact max_eq_left t.property

/-- Restriction of the stock BCF algebra as a real nonunital star hom. -/
def tailRestriction (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (TailTime n →ᵇ B) where
  toFun f := f.compContinuous (tailInclusion n)
  map_zero' := by
    ext t
    rfl
  map_add' := by
    intro f g
    ext t
    rfl
  map_smul' := by
    intro c f
    ext t
    rfl
  map_mul' := by
    intro f g
    ext t
    rfl
  map_star' := by
    intro f
    ext t
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem tailRestriction_apply (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) (t : TailTime n) :
    tailRestriction n B f t = f (tailInclusion n t) :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.compContinuous_apply _ _ _

/-- The actual constant-below-endpoint extension along the computed clamp. -/
def tailExtension (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    (TailTime n →ᵇ B) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) where
  toFun f := f.compContinuous (tailClamp n)
  map_zero' := by
    ext t
    rfl
  map_add' := by
    intro f g
    ext t
    rfl
  map_smul' := by
    intro c f
    ext t
    rfl
  map_mul' := by
    intro f g
    ext t
    rfl
  map_star' := by
    intro f
    ext t
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem tailExtension_apply (n : ℕ) (f : TailTime n →ᵇ B) (t : AsymptoticTime) :
    tailExtension n B f t = f (tailClamp n t) :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.compContinuous_apply _ _ _

/-- The two computed maps give an actual right-inverse identity. -/
theorem tailRestriction_extension (n : ℕ) (f : TailTime n →ᵇ B) :
    tailRestriction n B (tailExtension n B f) = f := by
  ext t
  rw [tailRestriction_apply, tailExtension_apply, tailClamp_inclusion]

theorem tailRestriction_surjective (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Function.Surjective (tailRestriction n B) :=
  fun f => ⟨tailExtension n B f, tailRestriction_extension n f⟩

/-- The source's exact tail ideal is a true closed kernel, not a model input. -/
def tailIdeal (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    ClosedStarIdeal (AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :=
  ClosedStarIdeal.ker (tailRestriction n B)

/-- Exact printed membership: zero at every source time at least n. -/
theorem mem_tailIdeal_iff (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    f ∈ tailIdeal n B ↔
      ∀ t : AsymptoticTime, (n : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ) → f t = 0 := by
  rw [tailIdeal, ClosedStarIdeal.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro h t ht
    have hv := DFunLike.congr_fun h (⟨t, ht⟩ : TailTime n)
    simpa only [tailRestriction_apply, tailInclusion_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using hv
  · intro h
    ext t
    simpa only [tailRestriction_apply, tailInclusion_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using h t.val t.property

/-- Monotonicity uses the literal nested-tail relation. -/
theorem tailIdeal_monotone (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Monotone (fun n : ℕ => tailIdeal n B) := by
  intro n m hnm f hf
  apply (mem_tailIdeal_iff m f).2
  intro t ht
  have hcast : (n : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hnm
  exact (mem_tailIdeal_iff n f).1 hf t (hcast.trans ht)

theorem tailIdeal_directed (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    Directed (· ≤ ·) (fun n : ℕ => tailIdeal n B) :=
  (tailIdeal_monotone B).directed_le

/-- Exact eventual zero implies membership in the real C0 ideal. -/
theorem tailIdeal_le_vanishingIdeal (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    tailIdeal n B ≤ BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B := by
  intro f hf
  apply (mem_vanishingIdeal_iff f).2
  have hzero : ∀ᶠ t : AsymptoticTime in atTop, f t = 0 := by
    let r : AsymptoticTime := ⟨max (n : ℝ) 1, le_max_right _ _⟩
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop r] with t ht
    exact (mem_tailIdeal_iff n f).1 hf t ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht)
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : AsymptoticTime => (0 : B)) atTop (nhds (0 : B)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  exact hconst.congr' (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm hzero)

/-- The actual restriction quotient is the actual tail BCF algebra. -/
def tailQuotientEquiv (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    (tailIdeal n B).Quotient ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] (TailTime n →ᵇ B) := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective
    (tailRestriction n B) (tailRestriction_surjective n B)

/-- Its characteristic formula is restriction of the original representative. -/
theorem tailQuotientEquiv_quotientMap (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    tailQuotientEquiv n B ((tailIdeal n B).quotientMap f) = tailRestriction n B f := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_quotientMap
    (tailRestriction n B) (tailRestriction_surjective n B) f

/-- The genuine stage-to-asymptotic quotient map is induced by the proven inclusion. -/
def tailToAsymptotic (n : ℕ) (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    (tailIdeal n B).Quotient →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AsymptoticAlgebra B := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMapOfLE
    (tailIdeal n B) (BoundedContinuousFunction.vanishingIdeal AsymptoticTime B)
    (tailIdeal_le_vanishingIdeal n B)

theorem tailToAsymptotic_quotientMap (n : ℕ) (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    tailToAsymptotic n B ((tailIdeal n B).quotientMap f) = quotientMap B f := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMapOfLE_quotientMap _ _
    (tailIdeal_le_vanishingIdeal n B) f

/-- The canonical stage transition uses the actual monotonicity proof. -/
def tailTransition {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m)
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal m B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal m B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    (tailIdeal n B).Quotient →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (tailIdeal m B).Quotient := by
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal m B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal m B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMapOfLE (tailIdeal n B) (tailIdeal m B)
    (tailIdeal_monotone B hnm)

theorem tailTransition_quotientMap {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m)
    (f : AsymptoticTime →ᵇ B) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal m B).Quotient :=
      (tailIdeal m B).quotientCStarAlgebra
    tailTransition hnm B ((tailIdeal n B).quotientMap f) =
      (tailIdeal m B).quotientMap f := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal n B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal n B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (tailIdeal m B).Quotient :=
    (tailIdeal m B).quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact ClosedStarIdeal.quotientMapOfLE_quotientMap _ _ (tailIdeal_monotone B hnm) f

end AsymptoticAlgebra
